rules.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank drives forward it may only do so if there are at least 80 pixels of free space ahead of it, and whenever it drives backward it may only do so if there are at least 80 pixels of free space behind it; if it doesn't drive at all, neither condition applies.

deleted_starters.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.
